about_the_game:
An Unexpected Adventure

Join Alvin as he set out to reclaim the legendary Snowflake Diamond and save his village from impending doom. Dive into a mesmerizing 2D world filled with lush wilderness and untold dangers in this thrilling, fun and retro-inspired adventure!

What to expect? Everything!

Alvin is on a ridiculously tough quest to recover the world’s most dazzling (and possibly magical) gem. No one else seems to care that it’s missing—but that won’t stop him. Armed with determination, a big jump, and zero planning, Alvin dives headfirst into chaos.

Key Features

  • Collect Gems – Unlock new powers that may seem simple, but they'll definitely help.

  • Explore Diverse Locations – Traverse enchanting forests, mystical caves, ancient ruins, and many other beautifully crafted hand-drawn environments.

  • Funny Dialogues – From bizarre characters and questionable advice to overly dramatic villains, expect dialogue that's weird, witty, and unexpectedly relatable.

  • Engage in Intense Battles – Face off against formidable enemies using a handful of weapons and special abilities, and master your combat skills to emerge victorious.

  • Meet Unexpected Allies – Make friends with strange but lovable characters. Just remember—they need your help too.

  • Discover Hidden Spots – Stay curious. Secret areas, weird side paths, and rewarding surprises await those who explore.

  • Beautiful Visuals – Immerse yourself in a simple yet unique 2D world that brings the story and characters to life.

  • Delightful Soundtrack – Enjoy a playful and atmospheric retro-inspired score that sets the mood for every twist, turn, and awkward boss fight along the way.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or higher
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 260, ATI Radeon 4870 HD, or equivalent card with at least 512 MB VRAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
